data.narrative:
Alice & Bob is a Series B quantum computing company founded by Theau Peronnin and Raphael Lescanne that has raised $104M to date. The quantum computing sector comprises 3 public comparables (IONQ, RGTI, QBTS) and 8 private peers including Quantinuum, IonQ, D-Wave Quantum, Rigetti Computing, and Infleqtion.

Valuation was triangulated using stage-progression methodology, the only applicable approach given data constraints. Using total raised ($104M) as a proxy for current valuation and applying a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement yields an implied valuation of $198M. A peer-median approach was not viable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the quantum computing universe—while 5 same-sector peers exist, none met the threshold of 3+ datapoints within relevant valuation tiers after filtering.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $168M (low) to $227M (high), with a median of $198M. This range reflects a ±15% confidence band around the single-method estimate. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the 1.9x multiplier for this particular market segment and timing of the Series B close relative to the comp universe snapshot. Investors should treat this as a preliminary estimate pending additional comps or disclosure of actual recent funding rounds within the quantum computing peer set.
